pattern: ^SELECT .+ AS .+ FROM .+ JOIN .+ ON .+ WHERE\s+CO.\w+\s+=\s+'T' (?: AND|GROUP BY|HAVING)\s*$
correction: Remove the GROUP BY and HAVING clauses, apply DISTINCT to the correct column (City ID), use proper boolean values ('true' or '1') instead of single quotes.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries with unnecessary GROUP BY and HAVING clauses, incorrect use of DISTINCT, and improper boolean values.
